title: incident-bot: enrich on-call diagnostics with runbook-aware context and SLO correlation
author: Elena Gomez
description: Motivation: On-call engineers frequently need correlated context when an SLO alert fires. The incident-bot currently posts SLO links and runbook references separately which places cognitive load on responders. This PR adds runbook-aware diagnostics: when an SLO alert is posted the bot now augments the on-call notification with the most-relevant runbook sections, recent postmortem links, and automatic correlation of recent SLO breaches (1h/6h/24h). It also surfaces top candidate mitigations and links to the last successful rollback/traffic-shift play. This improves time-to-mitigation and reduces noisy context-switching. What changed: added a new runbook_enricher module that fetches runbook metadata and canonical sections; extended the SLO toolkit integration with a correlation engine that queries recent breaches and serves a compact summary; added an oncall helper that attaches enriched context cards to alert threads; introduced a small cache for runbook lookups to avoid excessive API calls; added unit and integration tests; updated incident-bot docker image and CI job to include the new dependency for markdown-summarizer. Rollout plan: feature flag behind "runbook_enrichment" (default off). Gradual enablement for SRE and a single customer-facing playbook for 48h before wide rollout.
